checks.name: Correct supported equation remains draft/manual review, never automatic certification
Wrong correctIndex is independently blocked
Equation with two individually correct options is ambiguous and blocked
No correct supported option is blocked
Negative and positive alternatives are distinct
Fraction and decimal equivalent options are blocked
Percent and fraction equivalent options are blocked
All-of-the-above and combined answer options are blocked
Bounded nonempty options and explanation are required
Explicit incorrect arithmetic explanation is blocked
Do not extract a false constant equality from an equation embedded in prose
Unsupported geometry stays unverified rather than falsely exact
Pure arithmetic answer key is checked independently
Age-inappropriate harmful instructional content is blocked
Essay rubric total must match maximum points
Missing source supports manual review, not a verified-claim flag
Exact reference uses actual paragraph and discards invented locators
Physical page comes only from trusted extraction units
Timestamp is derived only from a literal transcript cue
Foreign source IDs and altered quotes are rejected
Ambiguous repeated quote needs the real paragraph
Review transition blocks provably wrong drafts
A valid topic-only lesson still needs human review
Lesson cannot reference an unselected material
Consent is mandatory before provider transport
Unknown student record and client context fields are rejected
Feedback is only a bounded explicitly typed anonymous excerpt
Detectable email, phone, identifier label and secrets are rejected
Counts, selected source count, duplicate IDs and task are bounded
Client idempotency key must be a UUIDv4 and cannot be empty or arbitrary
Generated question draft cannot auto-approve or bind a class
Generated question count and answer validation are enforced
Generated batch duplicate questions are blocked
Generated references are rebuilt, never model-certified pages
Generated lesson cannot smuggle foreign sources
Generated feedback cannot carry student names/grades as metadata
Generic AI input ignores hostile server-only teacher context
Only internal teacher context selects bounded draft schema

scope: Pure deterministic content QA and server-context regression; authored fixtures only. No teacher/student participants, live provider, OAuth, public deployment or device claims.
limits: Exact quote presence does not verify every claim.
Math checks cover narrow literal equations/arithmetic only; unknown cases require teacher review.
Safety/PII heuristics are not complete age classification or anonymization.
